description: The real admin account (admin@juice-sh.op) accepts the password 'admin123'. This is a genuine, live login against the real account, not a forged token or injection bypass, confirmed by Juice Shop's own scoreboard flipping 'Password Strength' to solved on the first attempt.
expected_exploit_indicator: HTTP 200 with a valid authentication.token whose decoded role is admin
legitimate_check: A freshly registered account logging in with its own, non-blocklisted password must still succeed in every condition.
